title: REVELIO: Universal Multimodal Task Load Estimation for Cross-Domain Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2509.01642v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adaptive interactive systems that respond to user mental state require task load estimation that stays reliable outside its training context. Models built in one setting rarely transfer, limiting real-world use. This work presents Robust Estimation Via End-to-End Learning of Multimodal Observations (REVELIO), a unified framework, dataset and evaluation protocol for cross-domain task load estimation. Cardiac, electrodermal, muscle, respiration, skin temperature, eye tracking and facial signals were recorded in 96 sessions, spanning a laboratory working memory task, a driving simulator and two games under consistent hardware and annotation. Multimodal fusion reached up to 0.87 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, above single input eye tracking (0.83), facial action units (0.74) and biosignals (0.62). translated_title: REVELIO：面向跨领域泛化的通用多模态任务负荷估计
translated_abstract: 响应用户心理状态的自适应交互系统需要在其训练环境之外仍保持可靠的任务负荷估计。在单一环境中构建的模型通常难以迁移，这限制了其实际应用。本工作提出了REVELIO（基于多模态观测端到端学习的鲁棒估计），这是一个用于跨领域任务负荷估计的统一框架、数据集和评估协议。研究在96个会话中，在一致的硬件和标注条件下，记录了心脏、皮肤电、肌肉、呼吸、皮肤温度、眼动追踪和面部信号，涵盖一个实验室工作记忆任务、一个驾驶模拟器和两个游戏。多模态融合的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）最高达到0.87，高于单输入的眼动追踪（0.83）、面部动作单元（0.74）和生物信号（0.62）。多领域训练在训练中见过的领域上保持校准，而移除目标领域会导致……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了REVELIO统一框架、数据集和评估协议，通过在实验室工作记忆任务、驾驶模拟器和游戏等多领域采集的96个会话多模态生理信号，实现跨领域任务负荷估计的鲁棒泛化，多模态融合AUC最高达0.87，显著优于单一信号输入。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces REVELIO, a unified framework, dataset, and evaluation protocol for cross-domain task load estimation, leveraging multimodal biosignals from 96 sessions across laboratory tasks, driving simulators, and games, achieving up to 0.87 AUC with multimodal fusion, outperforming single-input modalities.
